items.title: Kidd Jordan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 24, 2006
items.q: I got a chance when I first got the glimpse of playing free was with Illinois Jacquet honking and screaming.

ctx.x: Illinois. He told me, he say you were my, well the old man was old and he say, “you’re my last good student.” And he used to tell me, I loved horses. And he used to tell me Illinois Jacquet used to ride from Cade, Louisiana to his house on a horse. And I used to, he’d tell me about Illinois’ horse, and I loved horses. I still love them. So he used to tell me about that. And so this is one of the real things, and he’d be hyping me up with Illinois and I’d be playing anything, say hell you so and so and so. So he…
How did you learn to do that? Did you invent your own fingering?
